title: Absolute-Value Bound Under Update
statement: Let $k$ be a natural number, let $D$ assign an integer to each of the $k$ indices, and let $i$ be one such index. If every value of $D$ has absolute value at most $B$, and an integer $v$ also has absolute value at most $B$, then the function obtained by replacing $D(i)$ by $v$ has absolute value at most $B$ at every index.
